decisions.reason: As a consumer product far from the firm's core waste-to-value options and with no observed traction, its option value is low relative to the costs of maintaining a consumer brand.
The modular product line keeps multiple options close to the established engineering offer, and its keeping costs are manageable, so it is worth retaining while uncertainty resolves.
As a flagship with its own page and central to the waste-to-energy direction, it has received deeper commitment and retains substantial option value under remaining uncertainty.
Close to the established offer and flagged as a flagship, the plastic-waste-to-fuel option remains promising enough to keep while uncertainty continues to resolve.
